body: A wrapped loaf and a can of corn have the same pale field dust. The loaf is tied with twine, I think from a treated seed sack.
title: Bread and canned corn

body: At the picnic we were told a vehicle would come for each household. The first driver counted blankets spread on the grass instead. My little niece carried none, so I wrote her name twice to make sure she was seen.
title: Letter
